results.content: # From Iron Giants to Cloud Powerhouses — *A Blueprint for the Re-Platforming of Legacy Mainframe and AS/400 Information Systems*. ## Strategic Choices, Risks, and Returns in the $-Billion Mainframe Modernization Journey of how Today’s Leaders Can Turn Mainframe Modernization into a Strategic Growth Engine — A Field Guide to Migrating COBOL, CICS & RPG Workloads into Cloud-Native Architectures. > **tl;dr —** Mainframes and IBM i still power the world’s highest-value workloads but now threaten agility, cost, and talent pipelines. A phased, risk-managed re-platforming — combining re-hosting, refactoring, selective replacement, and cloud adoption — delivers up-to-80 % run-cost reduction, faster product cycles, and future-proof skills while safeguarding mission-critical reliability. > **Technical** — Inventory legacy apps, map dependencies, choose per-asset strategies (re-host, re-platform, refactor, replace, retire). ## Written by Adnan Masood, PhD. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
